description: Return peptide IDs and name matches for a name, alias or code. Use this before other calls when the name is unclear. Use search_peptides instead to browse or filter many peptides. Matching order: exact alias, normalized alias, trigram similarity, then edit distance. Normalization ignores letter case, spaces, hyphens and symbols. Greek letters use their names, so α-MSH matches alpha-MSH. Edit distance allows at most 2 typing errors against featured peptides only, so retratutide finds retatrutide. Trigram and edit_distance matches are guesses. An ambiguous status returns candidates without selecting a peptide.

name.description: Peptide name, alias or code. Example: BPC 157.
